observations: Three photos show a black microwave oven with a glass door and two rotary dials on the right side.
The brand name 'Scanfrost' is visible on the lower front panel in all three photos.
The microwave has a power level dial (Low, Med, High) and a timer dial (0-15 minutes).
The exterior surface is shiny and shows smudges, fingerprints, and light scratches, especially on the door and sides.
The door handle is metallic and vertical, located on the right side.
No power cord is visible in any photo.
The photos are taken indoors on a dark wooden surface, with reflections and glare on the surface.

claims.claim: Clean Microwave in good working condition
claims.evidence: The exterior shows smudges and scratches, but no interior view is provided. No proof of operation is shown. The claim of 'clean' is subjective and not verifiable from the photos.

risks.proof: Photo of the interior cavity, including turntable and walls.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially dirty or damaged, reducing value.

proof_requests: Photo of the interior of the microwave, including the turntable and walls.
Video clip showing the microwave in operation (turning on, running for 30 seconds, turning off).
Photo of the power cord and plug, showing full length and condition.
response.reason: The brand is identified as Scanfrost, but the model is not visible. The seller claims it is clean and working, but no interior view or proof of operation is provided. The exterior shows wear, and the absence of a power cord photo creates risk. Without proof of functionality and interior condition, the item cannot be priced accurately.
